scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "bun --cwd apps/backend run dev" "yarn --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun --cwd apps/backend run build && yarn --cwd apps/web build
scripts.test: bun --cwd apps/backend run test && yarn --cwd apps/web test
scripts.clean: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name 'dist' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name '.next' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' +
